FAQ Subtitle: Have more questions? Our team is available 6 days a week.
FAQ Q1: Do you modify the design to fit our spaces?
FAQ A1: Absolutely. Every piece is designed to precisely meet your space constraints, tastes, and the general atmosphere of your home.
FAQ Q2: What types of finishing do you offer?
FAQ A2: We offer an extremely wide range: matte, gloss, lacquer, brushed and natural, for both wood and metals.
FAQ A3: Yes, some of our premium fabrics (such as velvet and treated linen) benefit from the latest anti-stain technology for maximum durability.
FAQ Q4: Do you deliver to all cities?
FAQ A4: Yes, we handle logistics, transport, and installation by our professional artisans throughout Morocco.
